apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  labels:
    io.kompose.service: db
  name: db
  namespace: shop
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      io.kompose.service: db
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        io.kompose.service: db
    spec:
      containers:
        - env:
            - name: POSTGRES_DB
              value: shop
            - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
              value: example-not-a-real-password
            - name: POSTGRES_USER
              value: shop
          image: postgres:17
          name: db
          securityContext:
            capabilities:
              add:
                - SYS_NICE
            privileged: true
          volumeMounts:
            - mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
              name: db-data
            - mountPath: /backups
              name: db-claim1
      restartPolicy: Always
      volumes:
        - name: db-data
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: db-data
        - name: db-claim1
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: db-claim1
